s.gi: Chinese tech giants including ByteDance, Tencent and Alibaba are offering pay approaching 1 million yuan to attract forward-deployed engineers, who work directly with customers to integrate AI applications into business operations.

s.hl: Gas Supply may pursue remedies if contract breached following Indonesia’s export cuts: Tan See Leng
s.hk: Singapore's energy minister said Gas Supply will check with suppliers whether Indonesia's gas export cut breached contracts, and will pursue remedies if needed.
s.gi: Singapore's energy minister said Gas Supply will check with suppliers whether Indonesia's gas export cut breached contracts, and will pursue remedies if needed. The cut is under 2% of Singapore's daily gas demand, and replacement gas is sufficient.
s.why: Energy security and supply contracts matter here; Indonesia's cut is framed as prioritising its own domestic energy needs.

s.hl: Limiting yourself to English-language books to understand Brazil makes no sense anymore.

s.why: Shows AI tools can open non-English books to readers who don't speak the language.

s.hl: OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models
s.hk: Researchers found that training smartphone agents on more distinct apps, not more data, improves them, and their open OpenMobile-2 model scored…
s.gi: Researchers found that training smartphone agents on more distinct apps, not more data, improves them, and their open OpenMobile-2 model scored highest among open models on SPA-Bench on real Android devices.
s.why: Open alternatives to proprietary phone agents matter because training data for them is mostly held by big companies.
